A reasonable way to split the structure into connected fragments is to separate the aromatic‑chlorocarboxylic acid fragment from the methyl group that completes the ester. The two SMILES that can be joined to give the full structure are therefore:

1. The aromatic‑chlorocarboxylic fragment: Clc1ccc(cc1)C(=O)O  
2. The methyl fragment that caps the ester: C

These fragments can be combined (by forming the ester bond) to reconstruct the complete molecule.
